description: Recorded reasons for unverified items that exist only when a resident runtime is staged (PACKAGED). Read in addition to unverified-allowlist.json only then. This file gates nothing (docs/decisions.md P-09); a reason is a record, not legal sign-off.

entries.name: Bun JavaScript runtime (libeliza_bun.so)
entries.reason: Bun is MIT-licensed but statically links JavaScriptCore/WebKit (LGPL-2.0-or-later and LGPL-2.1-or-later, with BSD portions) and other native libraries listed in its LICENSE.md. The LGPL relink obligation for a statically linked library and the written source offer have not been confirmed.
